programme.desc: Action from Derby del Sole at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona as Napoli look to find some Serie A form against Gian Piero Gasperini's unbeaten Roma.

programme.title: Serie A: Udinese v AC Milan
programme.desc: Action from Bluenergy Stadium as AC Milan look to continue their unbeaten start to life in Serie A under Ruben Amorim against an Udinese side that has lost its last five matches.

programme.title: Serie A: AC Milan v Bologna
programme.desc: Ruben Amorim looks to continue his unbeaten start to life in Serie A with AC Milan as they host Raffaele Palladino's Bologna, who are fresh from victory over Lecce.

programme.title: Serie A: Monza v Napoli
programme.desc: After being held to a thrilling 3-3 draw by Roma, Massimiliano Allegri's Napoli search for a big win as they travel to face Ivan Juric's Monza at Stadio Brianteo.

programme.title: Serie A: Juventus v Napoli
programme.desc: After a shock midweek defeat to Genoa, 36-time champions Juventus face a huge test against former boss Massimiliano Allegri and his Napoli side at Allianz Stadium.

programme.title: Serie A: Atalanta v Parma
programme.desc: Following their thrilling 4-4 draw with Frosinone, Maurizio Sarri's Atalanta go in search of their fourth Serie A win of the season as they take on strugglers Parma at Gewiss Stadium.

programme.title: Serie A: Inter v Como
programme.desc: Inter look to bounce back from their Milan derby defeat as they host Cesc Fabregas' in-form Como side, who have won their last four Serie A games.

programme.title: Serie A: Fiorentina v Juventus
programme.desc: After beating Napoli 2-0 last weekend, Luciano Spalletti's Juventus look to build some momentum in Serie A as they travel to face Paolo Vanoli's Fiorentina.

programme.title: Gloucester-Hartpury Women's RFC v Harlequins Women
programme.desc: Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as league leaders Gloucester-Hartpury look to extend their unbeaten run against the Harlequins at Kingsholm.

programme.title: Loughborough Lightning Women v Bristol Bears
programme.desc: Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as Loughborough Lightning face Bristol Bears at cinch Stadium. The Lightning won 31-19 when these sides last met.

programme.title: Harlequins Women v Saracens Women
programme.desc: Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as Harlequins go head-to-head with title chasers Saracens at Twickenham Stoop.

programme.title: Saracens Women v...
programme.desc: ...Gloucester-Hartpury Women's RFC. Action from the huge Premiership Women's Rugby showdown between title-chasing rivals Saracens and Gloucester-Hartpury at StoneX Stadium.

programme.title: Leicester v Saracens
programme.desc: Saracens look to continue their unbeaten start to Group B of the PREM Rugby Cup as they face reigning champions Leicester Tigers at Mattioli Woods Welford Road.

programme.title: Rolex Spirit of Yachting
programme.desc: Coverage of the Rolex Middle Sea Race, a 606-nautical-mile event which sets sail from the historic Grand Harbour in Valletta.

programme.title: MLB World Series - Game 5
programme.desc: Action from game five at Tropicana Field. Can Tampa Bay Rays keep their World Series dream alive, or will the Milwaukee Brewers lift the title for the first time?

programme.title: UFC 334 - Gane vs Hokit
programme.desc: Action from Madison Square Garden and a huge UFC 334 card, headlined by the heavyweight title bout between Ciryl Gane and Josh Hokit.

programme.title: NWSL: Washington v Utah
programme.desc: Action from the National Women's Soccer League semi-final between Washington Spirit and Utah Royals FC at Audi Field.

programme.title: NWSL: Gotham FC v Kansas City
programme.desc: Action from the National Women's Soccer League semi-final clash between Gotham FC and Kansas City Current at Icahn Stadium.

programme.title: PL Legends: Robbie Fowler
programme.desc: This episode reflects on the Premier League career of former Liverpool forward Robbie Fowler, who is regarded by many as the best finisher to play in the English top flight.

programme.title: Ealing Trailfinders Women v...
programme.desc: ...Loughborough Lightning Women. Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as Ealing Trailfinders face Loughborough Lightning at Trailfinders Sports Club.

programme.title: Sarcens Women v Ealing Women
programme.desc: Action from the final day of the Premiership Women's Rugby regular season as Saracens host the in-form Ealing Trailfinders at StoneX Stadium.

programme.title: Gloucester-Hartpury v Trailfinders
programme.desc: Action from the Premiership Women's Rugby semi-final between defending champions Gloucester-Hartpury and Ealing Trailfinders at Kingsholm.

programme.title: Saracens Women v Exeter Women
programme.desc: Action from the Premiership Women's Rugby semi-final between Saracens and Exeter Chiefs at StoneX Stadium. Who will book a place in the Grand Final at the Twickenham Stoop?

programme.title: PWR Final: Saracens v Ealing
programme.desc: Action from the 2026 Premiership Women's Rugby final at Twickenham Stoop, as first-time finalists Ealing Trailfinders face last year's runners-up Saracens.

programme.title: Loughborough Women v Sarens Women
programme.desc: Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as Loughborough Lightning seek an upset against a high-flying Saracens side at cinch Stadium.
